title: RQP patch envelope (rqp/1, HTTP)
description: Normative text: docs/engineering/protocol/manifest-patch.md section 2. The schema does not check rules that need more than one value or the client state: block ids known and in document order, one operation per block, format of the block, content hashes, next_revision recomputation, content rules, byte sizes, duplicate member names.

operations.description: rqp/1 has one operation, replace_block (H-47). A new operation needs a new capability.

content.description: New block content. maxLength counts code points; the client also checks the UTF-8 byte length (maxBlockBytes).

sha256.description: SHA-256, base64url without padding, canonical form (the last character has its two low bits zero).
